title: Skin Diary Entry Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Curology prescriptions (`curology:prescription`), skin diaries (`skin:diary`), dermatology appointments (`derm:appointment`), and UV exposure logs (`uv:exposure`).
app: Curology prescription shipments, daily skin diary entries, dermatology appointment exports, and UV exposure tracker logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=skin:diary
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by concern_type
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when skin diary entry data has stopped arriving for a given concern.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per concern and alert when the feed is older than 72 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It measures when one part of your skin diary entry feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
